research_question: Which curvature conclusions survive predeclared model, likelihood, systematic, and cross-probe consistency tests?
required_invariants: Separate curvature geometry from global topology.
Retain Omega_K convention and priors with every constraint.
Treat Planck peak smoothing and reconstructed lensing as distinct evidence objects.
Treat an anomaly as non-unique until it passes alternative and independent-channel tests.
Do not report observed results in downstream design artifacts.
